passages.note: House Third Reading roll call records Martinez voting Y on final passage of the single-subject bill.

passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: The chaptered bill text bars students of the male sex from female-designated teams while leaving male and coed teams open to all, matching rung 4 and excluding a full ban.

rows.reasoning: Martinez voted Y on final passage of SB 1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose operative text requires each team be designated by biological sex and bars students of the male sex from female-designated teams while leaving male and coed teams open to all students, matching 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth' and excluding a complete ban. The vote occurred during her term as State Representative (2021-11-01 to 2023-01-09).
